mapper.select: SELECT condition_field, condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, select_label as label, select_value as value, search_key_field as searchKey, select_value as remoteLabel, value_type as valueType FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key = #{bussinessKey} and use_type = #{useType}

SELECT condition_field, case when field_belongs_type = 'main' then '基础信息-' || condition_field_name else table_cn_name || '-' || condition_field_name end AS condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, api_type, select_label, select_value, search_key_field, select_value, field_type, is_required, logic, field_belongs_type, bussiness_key, field_belongs_type FROM public.cfg_query_option cqo WHERE cqo.is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key = #{bussinessKey} and use_type = #{useType}

SELECT
FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE and use_type = #{params.useType} AND( bussiness_key IN ( SELECT bussiness_key FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE and use_type = #{params.useType} AND TABLE_NAME = #{params.tableName} AND sys_classify = #{params.sysClassify } LIMIT 1 ) or field_belongs_type = 'common')

SELECT condition_field, condition_field_name, request_method, controls, api_url, param, select_label as label, select_value as value, search_key_field as searchKey, select_value as remoteLabel, value_type as valueType FROM cfg_query_option WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND bussiness_key = #{bussinessKey} and use_type = #{useType} AND field_belongs_type = 'main' ORDER BY create_time
